subject.title: fix(gateway): detect unresolved env-var placeholders in gateway auth token

question: Should this TypeScript-only branch be retargeted or narrowed, or should a native macOS resolver PR carry the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101286?
rationale: Multiple open contributor PRs target the same P0 issue, and this branch changes a TypeScript resolver while the source-reproducible failure remains in the native macOS resolver path.

options.title: Prefer a native macOS fix
options.body: Use a native resolver PR as the likely canonical path once proof is acceptable, then ask this branch to close or narrow to separate TypeScript hardening.

options.title: Retarget this branch
options.body: Ask this author to replace the TypeScript-only change with a native macOS resolver fix, Swift tests, and live proof.

options.title: Keep separate TypeScript hardening
options.body: Treat this PR as separate auth hardening only if it is decoupled from the macOS issue and covers env-present, env-absent, and literal-token compatibility.

recommendation.title: Prefer a native macOS fix
recommendation.body: Use a native resolver PR as the likely canonical path once proof is acceptable, then ask this branch to close or narrow to separate TypeScript hardening.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is native macOS dashboard/gateway ownership and overlapping macOS PR coordination.
